name: opencode-pr-monitor
description: Explicit, session-bound pull request monitoring for OpenCode V2

scripts.format: prettier --write index.ts tui.ts src test scripts README.md SPEC.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.ts tui.ts src test scripts README.md SPEC.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
